events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Sir Mick Jagger, the iconic frontman of The Rolling Stones, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Mick Jagger's Enduring Energy
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still commanding stages worldwide! We're celebrating the one and only Mick Jagger today. What's your favourite Stones track?

events.title: MTV launched 45 years ago
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on this day in 1981, forever changing the music landscape, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' being the very first video aired.

angles.name: The Day Video Killed the Radio Star
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, MTV burst onto screens, kicking off with The Buggles. Did it really kill the radio star, or just give us more to love?

events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis's seminal debut album, 'Definitely Maybe', was released on August 29, 1994, marking a pivotal moment in Britpop history.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe's Britpop Legacy
angles.copy: Twenty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed everything. What's the track from that album that still gives you goosebumps?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in August 1969, becoming a defining moment of the counterculture generation.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace, love, and music. The spirit of Woodstock lives on.

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Elvis Presley in 1977; he would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley. His music continues to influence generations. What's your favourite Elvis hit?

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix in 1970; he would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who left us too soon. His electric legacy continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album was released in the UK on September 26, 1969, featuring some of their most beloved tracks.

angles.name: Abbey Road's Timeless Sound
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us the masterpiece that is 'Abbey Road'. The album cover alone is legendary.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: A huge happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude are as powerful as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a celebrated solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Bonehead, biblical, and 54 today! Wishing a very happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite track he's fronted?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' single anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK in 1975, becoming a global anthem for peace.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: First iPod released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music with '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: The iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod changed music forever. Remember carrying '1,000 songs in your pocket'? What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, naturally) to 007 and his incredible musical legacy. What's your favourite Bond theme?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have marked the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend, John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the extraordinary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedic icon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released in the UK on November 22, 1968, showcasing their diverse musical directions.

angles.name: The White Album's Diverse Sound
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed their sprawling 'White Album'. Which track from this double LP stands out for you?
